summary: CLI auth gate exfiltrates installer host identifiers, geolocation, and user-entered password to hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint
details: tajul-avengers 1.3.0 ships a mandatory `authenticateUser()` gate in bin/index.js that fires on every CLI invocation before any subcommand runs. The gate collects the installer's public IP, geolocation (city, region, country, latitude, longitude, postal code), ISP, OS, hostname, username, hardware specs, editor/terminal, Node and CLI version, project name, and the user-entered Employee ID and password, then GETs them as URL query parameters to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint at script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwA4nY0bnQSnMgsCvW1Ysjago5edRCdLfR36JAisIz1nQzx5XIpCOuNqffgMzrQIvA0dQ/exec that the installer did not configure and cannot override. The password is transmitted in cleartext as a `pass=` query parameter (logged in Google request logs) to a destination controlled by the package author rather than verified locally. The source also contains hardcoded 'Master Admin' credentials (MASTER_ADMIN_ID='15645', MASTER_ADMIN_PASS='54525645') that bypass the gate for anyone reading the package. The destination is not the installer's infrastructure and the behavior is not disclosed as telemetry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
